newsitem.title: CANADA: StatsCan survey sees Nov unemployment at 9.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: StatsCan survey sees Nov unemployment at 9.9 pct.

text.p: A Statistics Canada survey of analysts forecast Canadian unemployment to drop slightly to 9.9 percent in November from 10.0 percent in October.
The survey also forecast that consumer prices would rise in November by 1.7 pct from a year earlier.
The survey forecast gross domestic product to rise 0.2 percent in October from September.
The economists also forecast merchandise exports for October at C$23 billion and imports of C$20.1 billion.
The agency on average surveys 17 economists each month.
